name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 40 – Am 91
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 40a.Recalls that the development of political solutions designed to achieve peace, collective security and cooperation are the benchmarks for political and diplomatic action, involving the rejection of militarism and the arms race and insistence on compliance with the principles of the UN Charter and international law; deplores the ongoing escalation of EU militarisation;
